description: Gameplay footage from a dim flooded cave basin with rock formations, kelp and cave-wall textures. Tux swims around the basin, collects some of the coins floating there and interacts with objects in it; partway through, a group of new coins appears and the clip follows them until the end.
reproduces: https://github.com/SuperTux/supertux/issues/3729 (coins from a coin-burst block in Deep Dive 'n' Chill ignoring water), plus the two injected burst/landing defects; recorded on the task's buggy build (base commit + environment/bugs/*.patch)
scenario: data/levels/world1/deep_dive_chill.stl, unmodified geometry and objects; the level's first coin-explosion block (tile 2948 at x=864, y=2144), the exact repro from the issue. Captured headless (Xvfb + SDL renderer + ffmpeg x11grab) from the buggy build; Tux is placed in the block's basin at the start of the clip and driven by the scripting controller (wanders the basin, collects regular coins, swim-boosts into the block at ~0:07, then keeps exploring for ~35 s). The level-intro card is cut.
